seed42_learning_reference.reason: The start law and complete training goal set changed. Five-seed local training cost exceeded the predeclared 25% materiality threshold. Recalibrated the registered 2M/4M budgets with seed 42; all grid seed-42 learning and knowledge fields must reproduce that same-source pilot.

cost_recalibration_rule: Before new diagnostic results: treat a change above 25% in per-step training wall cost in any maze/agent as material, comparing five-seed 200k means with the archived goal diagnostics on the same laptop. New knowledge evaluation also changes body overhead, so any material whole-body change requires this seed-42 pilot at the registered grid budgets. Do not infer baseline performance from it.
budget_rule: Two million interactions times ceil(eight-action graph diameter / 10), equal for both agents. This geometry rule is fixed before learning under this protocol: 2M for Maze4, Maze5, Maze6, Maze7 and MazeMA; 4M for Woods14. It is a measurement horizon, not a convergence claim.

primary_metric.within_seed: Equally weighted mean success over every registered nominal evaluation point.
primary_metric.across_seeds: Mean and standard error across seeds 42-61; 95% Student t(19) interval, critical value 2.093024054408263.
primary_metric.paired_difference: ACS2ER minus ACS2 within each seed; mean and t(19) 95% interval across twenty differences.
primary_metric.threshold: First registered nominal point where across-seed mean test success reaches 0.5 times the test ceiling. No interpolation; null if never reached.

rejection_criterion.floor: If neither final test lower 95% confidence bound exceeds its random floor: floor_baselines_retain_for_successors.
rejection_criterion.ceiling: Otherwise, if ACS2 mean test success at the first point is at least 0.9 times its ceiling: too_easy_no_speed_ranking.
rejection_criterion.retention: Keep every configuration and all three blocks regardless of verdict.

secondary_metric.name: knowledge
secondary_metric.universe: All goals and multi-goal walkable transitions, no wall bumps or transitions starting at their own goal; strict q > theta_r and complete joined goal matching.
secondary_metric.summary: Mean, standard error and t(19) intervals at each point; equally weighted checkpoint means and paired ACS2ER-minus-ACS2 differences across seeds. Secondary only, no configuration rejection from knowledge.

cost_rule.job_limit: ceil((2.5 * seed42 body wall seconds at the registered budget + 90) / 60) minutes per agent. Mixed arrays use the larger limit for every element.
cost_rule.forecast: Twenty times the sum of new seed42 body wall at budget plus measured nonnegative allocation overhead. Report a doubled forecast separately. Both pilots use final allocation-only sacct CPUTimeRAW; do not add batch/extern/step rows.
cost_rule.layout: Six arrays of forty single-CPU jobs, one maze per array, concurrency forty, chained by afterok. Before every submission check all pilot costs plus spent, reserved and all new hard limits against forty CPU-hours.
